inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 16th February, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) warned today of active to occasionally strong northwesterly winds, raising dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 3,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The Centre stated in a statement issued today that the weather conditions began at 10:30 and will continue until 18:00, urging the public to exercise caution, particularly when driving on external and open roads, due to the risk of sudden drops in visibility caused by blowing dust.

requested_area.areaDesc: Coastal and inland areas, Abu Dhabi (demo zone)

fields.description: EXERCISE - Strong northwesterly winds are raising dust and sand. Visibility is below 3,000 m in some coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi until 18:00 today, 16 Feb. Visibility can drop suddenly.
fields.headline: EXERCISE: Blowing dust and low visibility in coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi until 18:00
fields.instruction: Drive with caution, especially on external and open roads, and be ready for sudden drops in visibility. Updates: https://alerts.example.ae
fields.note_for_reviewer: The source gives 10:30 to 18:00 without a time zone, so I assumed local UAE time and kept '18:00 today, 16 Feb'. The source says visibility is below 3,000 m only in 'some' areas, not across the whole demo zone, and I rated severity as Moderate based on that; please confirm both.

versions.description: تمرين - رياح شمالية غربية قوية تثير الغبار والرمال. مدى الرؤية أقل من 3,000 م في بعض المناطق الساحلية والداخلية من أبوظبي حتى الساعة 18:00 اليوم، 16 فبراير. قد ينخفض مدى الرؤية بشكل مفاجئ.

versions.instruction: قُد بحذر، خاصة على الطرق الخارجية والمفتوحة، وكن مستعداً لانخفاض مفاجئ في مدى الرؤية. التحديثات: https://alerts.example.ae

payload.summary: Hazard, timing (until 18:00 on 16 Feb), the 3,000 m visibility threshold, and Observed certainty all match the NCM bulletin. Moderate severity is consistent with a 'possible threat' driving hazard. Two fixes are needed. First, the alert limits the area to 'Abu Dhabi', which the bulletin does not say; 'Abu Dhabi' appears only in the WAM dateline. Second, the alert calls the winds 'strong' when the bulletin says 'active to occasionally strong'.

payload.summary: I compared the Arabic and English headline, description and instruction and found no difference in meaning. Both versions carry the EXERCISE / تمرين label, the hazard (blowing dust and sand from strong northwesterly winds), the visibility threshold (below 3,000 m) and the end time (18:00 today, 16 Feb). The areas match (some coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi), as do the warning that visibility can drop suddenly and the protective action: drive with caution, especially on external and open roads, and be ready for sudden drops in visibility. The update URL is identical. The Arabic was produced by machine translation, so a named Arabic reader at the issuing authority must still review and approve it before release. This review does not replace that sign-off.

'of Abu Dhabi' was removed. 'ABU DHABI' is only the WAM dateline, and the NCM bulletin names no emirate.

The wind wording ('active to occasionally strong northwesterly winds') is kept in the headline but dropped from the phone text. This keeps the phone text within one GSM-7 page (about 93 characters) without overstating the wind.

'Use low beams' and 'avoid travel if possible' were not used. The reviewer suggested them, but the NCM bulletin does not say them. The action follows the bulletin: caution when driving on external and open roads.
'Visibility can drop suddenly' was dropped from the phone text to fit one page. It is kept in the instruction.
No Arabic text was drafted, because this task asks for English only. The Arabic one-page limit (about 41 UCS-2 characters) still needs to be resolved by the operators and the authority.
